instructions: This project uses the RIPER workflow with 3 consolidated agents (research-innovate, plan-execute, review). See .claude/project-info.md for detailed context.

project.description: Color Dash is a fast-paced, educational, and addictive color-matching game designed to sharpen your understanding of RGB and HSL color models. Race against the clock to identify the target color from a set of options, aiming for a perfect score before time runs out!
project.name: ColorDash
